tariff.title: Tariff
tariff.description: Prices come from an Abode Power Tariffs entry. Leave empty and every hour is priced the same.

data_description.tariff_entry: The tariff that prices the house's electricity.

outdoor.title: Outdoor
outdoor.description: Outdoor readings the rooms' models learn from.

data_description.outdoor_temperature: Used by every room's model. Without it, the forecast's temperature is used.
data_description.outdoor_humidity: For the outdoor dew point and free-cooling advice.

forecast.title: Forecast
forecast.description: The hourly weather forecast the plan looks ahead with.

data_description.weather: A weather entity that gives an hourly forecast.

power.title: Power
power.description: The house's battery, solar and load. The power budget during a no-grid-import window needs the battery charge, size and reserve, the solar power and the house load; the rated discharge, the grid sensor and the solar forecast sources are optional.

data_description.battery_charge: The battery's state of charge, in %.
data_description.battery_size: The battery's usable capacity, in kWh.
data_description.battery_max_discharge: The most the battery can supply, in kW. Leave empty for no limit.
data_description.house_load: The whole house's power use. The air conditioners' draw is learned from it.
data_description.reserve_margin: Energy to keep in the battery, in kWh.
data_description.grid_power: Power to or from the grid. Used to check that no-grid-import windows are kept.
data_description.solar_forecast_sources: Leave empty to use the Energy dashboard's solar forecast.

grid_direction.title: Grid direction
grid_direction.description: Which way does a positive reading of {sensor} point? On Reconfigure it is pre-filled from the live readings where they decide it.

data_description.grid_positive_is_import: Importing from the grid, or exporting to it. Stored, and never changed while running.

announcements.title: Announcements
announcements.description: The speech engine for spoken warnings.

data_description.tts_engine: Leave empty to use the only one Home Assistant has.

room_1.title: The room
room_1.description: The room's air conditioners and sensors.

data.name: Name
data.opening_grace: Stop for an open door or window after

data_description.name: The room's name, shown on its device and in spoken warnings.
data_description.climate: Every air conditioner head in this room. A head can belong to only one room. Each one's live state is read when you save, so it must be reporting.
data_description.temperature_sensor: The room's own temperature sensor. The room's model is learned from it.
data_description.humidity_sensor: The room's own humidity sensor. The comfort index uses it.
data_description.presence_sensor: Leave empty and the room always counts as occupied. Needed for Precool.
data_description.sleep_schedule: A schedule, input boolean or binary sensor that is on while the room's occupants sleep. The sleep band applies then.
data_description.sun_sensor: Leave empty and the sun's position and the window direction decide whether the sun is on the glass.
data_description.openings: Door and window sensors. With one open, the unit is stopped after the wait below.
data_description.allow_blind_control: Lets the plan close the blinds when the sun is on the glass.
data_description.window_facing: The direction the windows face, for working out when the sun is on the glass.
data_description.overhang_projection: How far an eave or awning sticks out from the wall, in metres.
data_description.overhang_height: How far the overhang is above the bottom of the window, in metres.
data_description.occupied_grace: How long presence must be seen before the room counts as occupied, in minutes.
data_description.empty_grace: How long without presence before the room counts as empty, in minutes.
data_description.warning_grace: How long between the spoken warning and the unit stopping, in minutes.
data_description.announce: Speak a warning before the unit is stopped for an empty room or an open door or window.
data_description.announce_through: The speakers the warnings are spoken through.
data_description.opening_grace: How long a door or window may stay open before the unit is stopped, in minutes.
data_description.lockout_reason: Choose a reason, or type a new one, to keep the unit off. 'Not locked out' runs the room.

room_2.title: Air conditioner {count}
room_2.description: {climate}. Heads given the same outdoor-unit name share one compressor, in this room or another.

data_description.outdoor_unit: Choose a name already used or type a new one. Leave empty if this head has its own outdoor unit.
data_description.frequency_sensor: A sensor showing the compressor's frequency in Hz. It tells the component when the compressor runs.

room_3.title: Comfort
room_3.description: The comfort index is the temperature plus a part for humidity: index = temperature + 0.33 × vapour pressure (hPa) − 4. At 60 % humidity, an index of 23 is about 22 °C. The room is kept near the centre of the band in force.

data_description.occupied_low: The comfort index the room may fall to while occupied. 23 is about 22 °C at 60 % humidity.
data_description.occupied_high: The comfort index the room may rise to while occupied. 26 is about 24 °C at 60 % humidity.
data_description.sleep_low: The lowest comfort index while asleep.
data_description.sleep_high: The highest comfort index while asleep.
data_description.precool_low: The lowest comfort index during Precool.
data_description.precool_high: The highest comfort index during Precool.
data_description.power_management: Off: power is not limited. Guidance: the limit is shown, never applied. Enforced: the room is held within the house's power budget during a no-grid-import window.

error.no_climate: Choose at least one air conditioner.
error.not_reporting: {entity} is not reporting. Check it is on and connected, then save again.
error.ranges_do_not_overlap: These air conditioners' setpoint ranges do not overlap, so one setpoint cannot suit them all.
error.heads_take_different_setpoints: One of these air conditioners takes only a low and high setpoint, and another cannot take them, so nothing sent could suit them all.
error.band_inverted: The {band} band's low must be below its high.

abort.single_instance_allowed: The Abode HVAC Coordinator is already set up. Add rooms from its options.

remove_room.title: Remove a room
remove_room.description: The room's device and entities are removed with it, and what it has learned.

seed.title: Seed from history
seed.description: Replaces what the room has learned with its model run from the start over the recorder's history. A history that teaches nothing leaves the room as it was.

reset.title: Reset learning
reset.description: Returns the room's model to its starting figures, then seeds it from history.

confirm_seed.title: Seed {room}
confirm_seed.description: Seed {room} from the recorder's history? What it has learned is replaced by what its history teaches; a history that teaches nothing leaves it as it was. It runs in the background.

confirm_reset.title: Reset {room}
confirm_reset.description: Reset what {room} has learned, then seed it from history? This cannot be undone.

error.no_climate: Choose at least one air conditioner.
error.not_reporting: {entity} is not reporting. Check it is on and connected, then save again.
error.ranges_do_not_overlap: These air conditioners' setpoint ranges do not overlap, so one setpoint cannot suit them all.
error.heads_take_different_setpoints: One of these air conditioners takes only a low and high setpoint, and another cannot take them, so nothing sent could suit them all.
error.band_inverted: The {band} band's low must be below its high.

abort.reset_started: {room} has been reset; seeding has started.
abort.seeding_in_progress: {room} is already being seeded from history. Try again when it has finished.

not_loaded.message: The Abode HVAC Coordinator is not loaded.

unknown_room.message: No room has the id {room_id}. The room id is shown on the room's mode sensor.

precool_needs_presence.message: {room} has no presence sensor, so Precool cannot know when someone comes in.

memory_unreadable.message: The stored learning could not be read: {error}

no_room_can_run.message: No room can run this cycle.

automatic_control_on.message: {room} is run by Automatic control. Turn it off to change the unit yourself.

automatic_vane_control_on.message: {room}'s vanes are set by Automatic vane control. Turn it off to set them yourself.

profile_not_read.message: {room}'s air conditioners have not reported what they can do yet.

not_offered.message: {room}'s air conditioners do not offer {value} for the {control}.

spoken_empty_room.message: {room} is empty. The air conditioner turns off in {minutes} minutes.

spoken_opening_first.message: A door or window is open in {room}. The air conditioner turns off in {minutes} minutes.

spoken_opening_final.message: A door or window is still open in {room}. The air conditioner is turning off.

unknown_constraint.title: A tariff rule is not known
unknown_constraint.description: The tariff declares {constraints}, which this version does not know. It is shown in each room's trace and never dropped. Update the Abode HVAC Coordinator, or remove the rule from the tariff.

tariff_unreadable.title: The tariff cannot be read
tariff_unreadable.description: Abode Power Tariffs did not give its intervals: {error}. Every hour is priced the same until it does. Check the Abode Power Tariffs entry is loaded.

no_speech_engine.title: No speech engine
no_speech_engine.description: A room announces warnings, but Home Assistant has no speech engine. Add one, or turn announcements off in the room's options.

speech_engine_not_chosen.title: Choose a speech engine
speech_engine_not_chosen.description: Home Assistant has {count} speech engines and none is chosen. Choose one in Reconfigure, on the Announcements screen.

solar_forecast_unreadable.title: The solar forecast cannot be read
solar_forecast_unreadable.description: The solar forecast failed: {error}. Check the forecast integration, or remove it from the Power screen in Reconfigure.

grid_sign_contradicted.title: The grid sensor's direction looks wrong
grid_sign_contradicted.description: The grid readings have contradicted the direction set up ten times in a row. Check it in Reconfigure, on the Grid direction screen, which is shown while this stands. It clears once ten readings in a row agree.

grid_import.title: Grid import during a no-grid-import window
grid_import.description: The house imported {kwh} kWh during the last no-grid-import window. Check the battery's settings and the rooms' power management.

shared_climate.title: An air conditioner is in two rooms
shared_climate.description: {entity} is used by {rooms}. Both rooms are locked out until it is removed from one of them in the options.

room_sensor_missing.title: A room's sensor is missing
room_sensor_missing.description: {room} uses {entity}, which Home Assistant has not provided for 15 minutes. Check the integration it comes from, or choose another sensor in the room's options.

filter_silent.title: A room's model has stopped learning
filter_silent.description: {room}'s model has learned nothing for 24 hours: {reason}. It still follows the room's readings. Check the room's sensors and its air conditioner.

precool.name: Precool
precool.description: Starts Precool in an empty room: it runs to the centre of its precool band until the room counts as occupied or it is ended. A room counts as occupied for its empty grace after the last person leaves, so Precool started in that time ends at once.

room_id.name: Room id
room_id.description: The room's id, shown on its mode sensor.

ready_by.name: Ready by
ready_by.description: The room is to be in its precool band by then; it starts when the model says it must. Leave empty to start now.

room_id.name: Room id
room_id.description: The room's id, shown on its mode sensor.
